prop: s.size = operations.length + 1 ∧ s[0]! = 0 ∧ ∀ i, i < operations.length → s[i+1]! = s[i]! + operations[i]!

children.invariant: i ≤ operations.length ∧ acc.size = i + 1 ∧ acc[0]! = 0 ∧ ∀ j, j < i → acc[j+1]! = acc[j]! + operations[j]!

lemmas.name: exit108
lemmas.statement: ∀ (ops : List Int) (s : Array Int) (h : below_zero_precond ops), (s.size = ops.length + 1 ∧ s[0]! = 0 ∧ ∀ i, i < ops.length → s[i+1]! = s[i]! + ops[i]!) → below_zero_postcond ops (s, (List.range ops.length).any (fun i => decide (s[i+1]! < 0))) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro ops s h hp
  obtain ⟨hs, h0, hstep⟩ := hp
  unfold below_zero_postcond
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨hs, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : 0 < s.size := by omega
    rw [getElem?_pos s 0 this]; simp [← getElem!_pos s 0 this, h0]
  · rw [List.all_eq_true]
    intro i hi
    have hi' : i < ops.length := by simp at hi; omega
    have hlt : i + 1 < s.size := by omega
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    rw [getElem?_pos s (i+1) hlt, ← getElem!_pos s (i+1) hlt, hstep i hi']
  · intro hany
    exact hany
  · intro hnone
    rw [← Array.all_toList, List.all_eq_true]
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    rw [Refine.forall_mem_toList_iff_idx]
    intro k hk
    rcases k with _ | k
    · rw [h0]
    · have hn := List.any_eq_false.mp hnone k (List.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
      simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hn
      omega
